children: U.S. WTI Midland and North Sea Forties crude fell on Tuesday after lower offers.
Indications are free on board (FOB) unless marked as cost, insurance and freight (CIF) or delivered at place.
* No cargoes traded, a market source said.
WTI Midland: Trafigura offered Sept 13-19 at dated Brent plus $1.05 on a CIF basis, equating to dated minus 69 cents FOB, according to Reuters calculations.
Forties: Mercuria offered September 16-22 on a CIF basis at dated Brent plus $1.15, equating to dated minus 85 cents FOB, according to Reuters calculations.
